correctness.rationale: For H_n=K_n square K_2, exact distance-two signatures at (0,i),(1,i) are B\{i}, A\{i}. Nonempty signatures in opposite layers cannot coincide. In-layer collisions require |A union B|>=n-1, while missing witnesses force the three boundary patterns for empty and singleton layers. Multiplying (2z+z^2)^n and allowing one empty column then subtracting the three disjoint forbidden patterns yields the stated P_n, including the explicit n=3 double-count correction. Deletion minimality reduces for n>=5 to disjoint A,B partitioning n-1 columns with layer cardinalities>=2, plus the empty/full and singleton boundary classes; n=3,4 are handled individually. Independently enumerated every subset of the actual adjacency graph for n=3..7, testing exact distance-two signatures and all single-deletion minimality. Counts n=3..7: all (36,149,588,2103,7178), minimal by cardinality (14 at 3;56 at4;30 at4+42 at5;120 at5+62 at6;350 at6+86 at7), matching P,Q. Source script and verification note were read but not accepted as proof of n>7.
residual_risks: Finite checks stop at n=7 and prove no theorem for unrestricted n without the presented case analysis.

value.rationale: The complete prism/crown is a canonical symmetric graph family; not merely a new notation. The complete labeled-cardinality and inclusion-minimal enumerators refine its locating-hop domination number and exhibit the structurally meaningful five-column change, which can be used in graph-identification and locating-domination polynomial work. Both enumerators require a nontrivial boundary case and minimal-deletion classification, not a generic substitution.
